pages.title: Earned by a Well-Fed Frog
pages.text: Get it the way Suwako would: put a straw hat on a frog, then let that frog eat raiders. Once it has swallowed enough different raider types, the hat comes off. How many is a server setting, so ask if you are playing on a server.

$(bold)While worn$(br)The hat refreshes Native God's Bless on you every tick, so it never runs out — it raises your movement speed and your reach — and it adds 25% magic damage on top of everything else you are wearing.$(br2)$(bold)Counting the meal$(br)Each distinct raider type the frog swallows counts once, and the tally belongs to the frog, not the hat: a second frog needs its own hatful. Only one frog can wear the straw hat at a time, and a frog without it will not touch raiders at all.
